name: AlphaEarth annual landscape context over a named site
description: Average the 64 AlphaEarth Foundations satellite embedding bands for one year over a named site inside Google Earth Engine. Returns one summary vector with dataset and model versions; no imagery is downloaded.
planner_guidance: Use alphaearth_context for annual landscape context at a named site, for example to compare one year with another.
Pass a completed year from 2017 onward. A year without a published layer returns zero images, which is a coverage gap.
Embedding dimensions are learned features, not physical measurements, and an annual layer cannot resolve a bloom or any other short event.

arguments.name: site
arguments.description: A named study site. Each site is a fixed approximate bounding box recorded in the result.

arguments.name: year
arguments.description: A completed calendar year, YYYY, from 2017.

sources: Google AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding V1, Earth Engine collection GOOGLE/SATELLITE_EMBEDDING/V1/ANNUAL

limitations: Embedding dimensions are learned features, not individual physical measurements.
The mean of unit-length embeddings is shorter than one; its length reflects how varied the site is.
An annual layer cannot resolve daily or seasonal events.
The site is an approximate bounding box that mixes water, shoreline and land.

policy_constraints.attribution: The AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dataset is produced by Google and Google DeepMind. Licensed CC BY 4.0. Earth Engine use requires a registered Cloud project and is subject to Earth Engine terms.
